title: Glowing ice cream cone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <polygon points='36,52 64,52 50,92' fill='#c98a3a'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='17' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='42' r='9' fill='#ffc2da'/>

  <rect x='47' y='44' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#b57bff' transform='rotate(-30 47 44)'/>
  <!-- cherry -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='17' r='4.5' fill='#ff3b3b'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='15.5' r='1.6' fill='#ff9a9a'/>
  <path d='M50 13 Q52 7 57 8' stroke='#5ad06a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
